title: Build local Ableton Live MCP server
acceptanceCriteria: Provides an MCP stdio server exposing Ableton-oriented tools
Includes a local bridge strategy for Ableton Live control
Includes setup and smoke-test documentation
Provides MCP tools for VST/plugin inventory and selection for MIDI tracks
Provides MCP tools for MIDI import and clip creation
Provides MCP tools for export/render and mastering chains
Provides MCP tools for modifying project tracks, mixer state, devices, and automation through the local bridge
assumptions: Ableton control will run through a local bridge such as Max for Live
or a future Live API adapter rather than direct DAW memory access.
goal: Create a local MCP stdio server that can expose safe Ableton Live control commands through a local HTTP/UDP bridge and document how to connect it from an MCP client.
scope: Add a Node-based MCP server, bridge abstraction, smoke test, README usage instructions, and production-focused Ableton tools for VST selection, MIDI import, rendering, mastering, and project track modification.
testStrategy: Validate server module syntax and run a JSON-RPC smoke test over stdio without requiring Ableton to be installed.

title: Review codebase patterns and implementation consistency
goal: Review the project code, identify architectural and implementation patterns, and report whether the current code follows those patterns.
blockedReason: qa requested changes: MIDI clip note validation is incomplete: schema declares pitch/start/duration/velocity constraints, but validateToolInput only checks notes is an array; invalid note values are accepted and forwarded. list_plugins accepts kind/query but the real GET bridge call sends GET /plugins with no query/body, so filters are dropped outside dry-run. Bridge config reads ABLETON_BRIDGE_URL and ABLETON_BRIDGE_TIMEOUT_MS directly without startup validation or local-only enforcement, despite local-bridge/security rules. src/server.js is 350 lines and mixes tool registry, dispatch, protocol loop, validation, and schema helpers, exceeding the local 300-line module-boundary threshold. README MCP client config references a stale absolute path outside this repo.

title: Fix code pattern review findings
goal: Fix code review findings: deep MCP input validation, GET plugin filter forwarding, startup config validation/local bridge policy, module boundary cleanup, and README path correction.
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid MIDI note values are rejected before reaching the bridge.
ableton_list_plugins forwards kind/query filters to the HTTP bridge in real mode.
Bridge configuration is centralized and validated at startup, including timeout and local-only URL policy.
server entrypoint is reduced below the local 300-line module-boundary threshold by extracting focused modules.
README client config references the current repo path and tests cover happy path plus new failure cases.

title: Implement minimal Ableton local bridge
goal: Create a minimal local HTTP bridge implementation with adapter boundaries for Ableton control and development-mode behavior for status, project, tempo, transport, and plugin inventory endpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: A local bridge server can listen on 127.0.0.1:9789 or a configured loopback port.
The bridge implements /status, /project, /tempo, /transport/start, /transport/stop, and /plugins according to docs/ableton-bridge-contract.md.
The bridge has a clear adapter seam for real Ableton integration and a deterministic development adapter for local tests.
Tests verify the MCP server can call the bridge without ABLETON_MCP_DRY_RUN for status, tempo, transport, and plugins.

title: Validate MCP against real Ableton bridge
goal: Run the MCP server against the local bridge in non-dry-run mode and capture real integration evidence for status, project, tempo, and transport.
acceptanceCriteria: A non-dry-run smoke test exercises the MCP server through the HTTP bridge.
Evidence captures request/response shape and observable bridge state changes.
Any Ableton-unavailable constraint is documented with a deterministic local substitute and owner for live verification.

title: Implement snapshot and rollback bridge contract
goal: Implement snapshot persistence/rollback semantics for safe broad edits through the Ableton bridge contract.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /project/snapshot creates a named snapshot artifact or adapter checkpoint.
Rollback or restore behavior is documented and testable.
MCP snapshot calls are covered by tests and failure modes return contract-shaped errors.

title: Implement MIDI clip and import bridge features
goal: Implement /clips/midi and /midi/import bridge behavior with validated note/import payload handling and MCP integration tests.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /clips/midi accepts validated notes and updates bridge project state or real Ableton adapter.
POST /midi/import validates .mid/.midi import requests and exposes deterministic behavior in development mode.
Tests cover success and invalid payload cases through MCP-to-bridge flow.

title: Implement Ableton plugin inventory indexing
goal: Implement searchable plugin/device/preset inventory for /plugins with kind/query filtering and MCP integration coverage.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /plugins supports kind and query filters.
Development adapter exposes deterministic fixtures for instruments/effects/racks/presets.
Real Ableton adapter integration path for device/preset discovery is documented with known limitations.

title: Implement real Ableton Python Remote Script adapter
goal: Add an installable Ableton Python Remote Script bridge that runs inside Ableton Live and implements the real local HTTP adapter endpoints for status, project, tempo, transport, plugin lookup, device loading, and mastering-chain application.
acceptanceCriteria: An Ableton MIDI Remote Script package exists with create_instance and a ControlSurface class that starts a loopback HTTP server.
The script implements the same endpoint contract used by the MCP bridge for status, project, tempo, transport, plugins, device loading, and mastering apply.
Live API calls are marshalled onto Ableton's control-surface thread instead of directly mutating Live from the HTTP thread.
Docs explain install location, Ableton preferences setup, startup verification, and the smoke command against Live.
Static validation covers Python syntax and repository tests still pass; live Ableton validation is explicitly deferred with owner and command.

title: Document Ableton Remote Script app-bundle permission workaround
goal: Improve installer and docs for macOS App Management/TCC failures when copying the Ableton Remote Script into the Ableton app bundle.
acceptanceCriteria: Installer failure output explains App Management/Full Disk Access and Finder/manual alternatives when mkdir or cp fails with Operation not permitted.
Docs mention that sudo may still fail on modern macOS and provide concrete remediation steps.

title: Remove project-specific music artifacts from Ableton MCP repo
goal: Remove external music project setup, tests, docs, workflow metadata, and old Remote Script branding so the repo remains a generic Ableton MCP connector.
acceptanceCriteria: No repository source/docs/tests/package references contain external music project setup.
Remote Script package is generically named and tests/docs/install script use the new name.
Project tests pass after cleanup.

title: Add Ableton MIDI clip delete endpoint
goal: Expose a bridge and MCP tool endpoint to delete an existing clip by track index and clip slot index.
acceptanceCriteria: Remote Script handles DELETE /clips/midi and deletes the target clip when it exists.
Development adapter and HTTP bridge support the same delete clip contract.
MCP exposes ableton_delete_clip with input validation.
Docs and tests cover successful deletion and missing clip behavior.

title: Enable DELETE method in Ableton Remote Script HTTP server
goal: Add HTTP DELETE method support to the Python Remote Script server so DELETE /clips/midi reaches the bridge handler.
acceptanceCriteria: Remote Script HTTP server implements do_DELETE.
Static tests assert DELETE method support.
Remote Script Python files compile and npm test passes.

title: Add save signature and clip note endpoints
goal: Enable MCP control for saving the current set, setting time signature, and reading MIDI notes from clips.
acceptanceCriteria: MCP exposes ableton_save_project, ableton_set_signature, and ableton_get_clip_notes.
Development bridge and Remote Script implement POST /project/save, POST /signature, and GET /clips/notes.
Tests cover tool dispatch and bridge behavior for save, signature, and clip-note readback.
Docs describe the new endpoints and operational limitations.

title: Verify live Ableton new endpoints
goal: Verify the currently selected Ableton Remote Script exposes the newly added save, signature, and clip-note endpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /clips/notes returns note data from a live clip.
POST /signature returns the expected 3/4 signature.
POST /project/save returns a contract-shaped response or a documented API limitation.

title: Fix Live clip note readback get_notes arguments
goal: Fix GET /clips/notes against Ableton Live by using the Clip.get_notes argument order expected by Live 12.
acceptanceCriteria: Remote Script uses Clip.get_notes(from_time, from_pitch, time_span, pitch_span).
Remote Script Python files compile.
Evidence records the live failure and corrected implementation.

title: Use explicit float arguments for Live get_notes
goal: Make GET /clips/notes compatible with Ableton Live 12 Boost.Python get_notes signature by passing explicit float arguments.
acceptanceCriteria: Remote Script calls clip.get_notes with explicit float from_time and time_span arguments.
Remote Script Python files compile and npm test passes.
Evidence records live error and required reinstall/reload.

title: Clean stale Orchestra metadata references
goal: Restore Orchestra workflow health by removing stale references to deleted historical music-task records.

title: Verify reinstalled Ableton Remote Script endpoints
goal: Verify that the reinstalled AbletonMcpBridge exposes the newly implemented snapshot/rollback and plugin inventory endpoints against the running Live bridge.
blockedReason: Running Ableton process PID 35269 predates the Remote Script reinstall and is still serving old in-memory code. Full Ableton process quit/restart is required before verification can pass.

title: Implement effective Ableton mixing endpoints
goal: Make volume, pan, sends/returns, bus routing, device parameter, and master-chain endpoints apply observable changes or return explicit contract-shaped failures instead of no-op success.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /tracks/modify applies track volume, pan, mute/solo/arm, sends, and routing in development and Remote Script adapters.
Return-track and bus/routing surfaces are exposed through MCP tools and documented endpoints.
POST /devices/parameter applies device parameters or returns a clear 404/400 failure.
POST /mastering/apply only reports loaded/applied devices and parameter settings that were actually attempted, with warnings for unavailable devices or settings.
Tests cover effective behavior and failure modes.

title: Validate effective mixing endpoints
goal: Validate local tests, installed Remote Script freshness, and non-destructive live behavior for the effective mixing endpoint implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Repository tests and Remote Script compilation pass.
Installed AbletonMcpBridge files match the endpoint surface implemented in the repo.
Live bridge exposes non-destructive endpoints and explicit failure modes for no-op mastering or missing parameters.

title: Expose device parameter inventory
goal: Implement GET /devices/parameters and MCP tool support to list real device parameters, ranges, current values, and enablement before mutation.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /devices/parameters supports trackIndex plus deviceIndex or deviceName filters.
MCP exposes ableton_get_device_parameters with input validation.
Development and Remote Script adapters return deterministic/real parameter metadata and 404 for missing targets.

title: Expose master mixer modification
goal: Implement POST /master/modify and MCP tool support for master volume, pan, mute/cue-related mixer state where supported.
acceptanceCriteria: Master mixer fields can be modified and read back.
Unsupported master fields return warnings or contract-shaped errors.

title: Expose track return and master metering
goal: Implement GET /meters and MCP tool support for observable track, return, and master levels when Live exposes meter values.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /meters returns track, return, and master meter data.
Unavailable meter data is explicitly null or warned, not fabricated.

title: Expose return track creation
goal: Implement POST /returns/create and MCP tool support to create named return tracks for reverb, delay, and parallel buses.
acceptanceCriteria: Return tracks can be created in development and Live where supported.
Created return appears in /returns and /routing/buses.

title: Expose return track deletion
goal: Implement DELETE /returns and MCP tool support to remove return tracks safely when supported.
acceptanceCriteria: Return deletion validates returnIndex and reports deleted state.
Unsupported Live deletion returns explicit 501 or contract-shaped failure.

title: Expose device reorder
goal: Implement POST /devices/reorder and MCP support to move devices in a track, return, or master chain.
acceptanceCriteria: Device reorder validates source and target indices.
Unsupported Live reorder returns explicit limitation evidence.

title: Expose master device loading
goal: Implement POST /devices/load-master and MCP support to load a device or preset directly onto the master track.
acceptanceCriteria: Master device loading selects master and reports the actual loaded device.
No matching loadable item returns 404.

title: Expose device deletion
goal: Implement DELETE /devices and MCP support to remove devices from tracks, returns, or master.
acceptanceCriteria: Device deletion works by location and deviceIndex.
Missing location or device returns contract-shaped errors.

title: Expose MIDI clip humanization
goal: Implement POST /clips/humanize and MCP support for controlled MIDI timing, duration, and velocity variation.
acceptanceCriteria: Humanize supports deterministic seed for repeatable tests.
Payload bounds prevent destructive timing or velocity changes.

title: Expose arrangement timeline reading
goal: Implement GET /arrangement and MCP support to inspect arrangement timeline clips, markers, length, and section layout.
acceptanceCriteria: Arrangement read returns timeline clips when exposed by Live.
Session-only limitations are documented with evidence.

title: Expose MIDI clip quantization
goal: Implement POST /clips/quantize and MCP support to quantize MIDI clip notes where Live exposes quantization or through note rewrite fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: Quantize accepts trackIndex, clipSlotIndex, grid, and strength.
Bridge reports changed note count or explicit unsupported failure.

title: Implement automation writing
goal: Implement POST /automation behind the existing MCP tool for volume, pan, sends, tempo, and device parameters where Live permits automation envelopes.
acceptanceCriteria: Automation validates target grammar and points.
Unsupported automation surfaces return explicit errors instead of no-op success.

title: Implement locator creation
goal: Implement the declared locator MCP tool through POST /arrangement/locators for creating or updating arrangement markers.
acceptanceCriteria: Locator create/update is effective in development and Live where supported.
GET /project locators reflect changes or unsupported failure is explicit.

title: Expose rendered audio analysis
goal: Implement POST /analysis/audio and MCP support for LUFS, true peak, RMS, crest factor, and clipping analysis of rendered files.
acceptanceCriteria: Audio analysis validates local file paths and supported formats.
Analysis uses real local tooling or returns explicit missing-tool errors.

title: Expose arrangement insertion
goal: Implement POST /arrangement/insert and MCP support to place MIDI/audio clips at beat positions in the arrangement when supported.
acceptanceCriteria: Insert validates track, source clip, startBeat, and length.
Unsupported arrangement insertion returns explicit 501.

title: Implement render export
goal: Implement POST /render/export behind the existing MCP tool for master, all tracks, selected tracks, or stems when Live exposes export APIs.
acceptanceCriteria: Render export validates path, scope, sample rate, bit depth, and range.
Live unsupported surfaces return explicit 501 with docs.

title: Expose track duplication
goal: Implement POST /tracks/duplicate and MCP support for duplicating tracks for layers, doubles, and parallel processing.
acceptanceCriteria: Duplicate validates source track and returns new track index.
Development adapter and Live behavior are covered or limitations documented.

title: Expose clip consolidation
goal: Implement POST /clips/consolidate and MCP support to consolidate clip ranges where Live exposes the operation.
acceptanceCriteria: Consolidate validates track/range inputs.
Unsupported operation returns explicit 501.

title: Expose track freeze and flatten
goal: Implement POST /tracks/freeze and POST /tracks/flatten plus MCP support for committing instrument tracks to audio where supported.
acceptanceCriteria: Freeze/flatten validates track target and reports resulting state.
Unsupported Live surfaces return explicit 501.

title: Implement analyze-and-apply mastering workflow
goal: Implement POST /mastering/analyze-and-apply to render/analyze/apply iterative mastering adjustments using lower-level endpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: Workflow composes render, audio analysis, master/device parameter changes, and final report.
Each skipped step has explicit rationale and no simulated QA evidence.

title: Expose groove application
goal: Implement POST /groove/apply and MCP support to apply groove/swing to MIDI clips where Live exposes groove APIs or through note rewrite fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: Groove apply validates clip target and groove amount.
Unsupported groove APIs return explicit limitation evidence.

title: Expose track audio bounce workflow
goal: Implement a bounce-oriented workflow endpoint for rendering selected tracks or stems into audio artifacts for production decisions.
acceptanceCriteria: Bounce workflow validates target tracks and output path.
It composes render/export where possible or returns explicit unsupported state.

title: Expose production session report
goal: Implement a production report endpoint/tool summarizing tracks, buses, devices, parameters, meters, clips, routing, and known risks before mix/master actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Report aggregates existing read endpoints into one actionable production snapshot.
Report marks missing capabilities and non-audited changes explicitly.

title: Expose general browser search
goal: Implement GET /browser/search and MCP support for presets, samples, racks, grooves, plugins, and Max devices beyond plugin inventory.
acceptanceCriteria: Browser search accepts kind/query and returns loadable metadata.
Results are capped and typed for safe selection.

title: Modularize oversized Ableton adapters
goal: Split oversized development and Remote Script adapter modules into smaller domain modules while preserving the public bridge and MCP contracts.
acceptanceCriteria: Development adapter behavior is split by domain or helpers so endpoint additions do not keep growing one monolith.
Ableton Remote Script Live API code is organized into smaller importable domain modules or package helpers without changing HTTP route behavior.
Public MCP tools, bridge action names, and documented endpoint contracts remain backward compatible.
npm test and Python Remote Script compilation pass after the refactor.

title: Validate reinstalled Ableton bridge endpoints
goal: Validate the reinstalled AbletonMcpBridge against the running Ableton Live bridge and record endpoint behavior and evidence.
blockedReason: Resolved after full Ableton restart; live read-only endpoint validation passed.

title: Analyze product gaps for Ableton MCP
goal: Identify the remaining product capabilities needed to make Ableton MCP useful and packageable for production and music workflows.
acceptanceCriteria: Product roadmap lists the 10 remaining capabilities with priority and implementation ownership.
Each capability is converted into an actionable Orchestra task with clear acceptance criteria and paths.
Independent work is delegated to subagents with non-overlapping scopes.

title: Implement real render and export product path
goal: Close the product gap around export/render so production workflows can produce inspectable audio artifacts or explicit unsupported results.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the product contract for master export, selected-track export, and stem export with explicit Live Remote Script feasibility.
Add or update deterministic tests for render/export behavior and unsupported Live fallback semantics.
Document remaining Live API limitations and the next implementation surface if Remote Script cannot render directly.

title: Build live Ableton smoke suite by risk level
goal: Make real Ableton validation repeatable and risk-tiered instead of manual curl probes.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a read-only live smoke suite covering status, project, meters, browser, arrangement, devices, returns, and routing.
Define separate safe-write and destructive suites gated by explicit environment variables.
Document how to run live smokes without accidentally mutating a user set.

title: Add installer verification and doctor diagnostics
goal: Make installation and stale bridge troubleshooting product-grade.
acceptanceCriteria: Provide a doctor command that reports Ableton app path, installed Remote Script path, file freshness, Live PID, bridge status, and stale-runtime diagnosis.
Improve installer guidance so users can verify installation without manual curl commands.
Add tests or deterministic checks for diagnostic output where feasible.
blockedReason: developer requested changes: Implementation and deterministic validation pass. Release still needs live Ableton validation because this workspace cannot observe an actual Ableton Live Remote Script runtime.
testStrategy: npm test plus escalated npm run doctor against Ableton Live 12 Lite.app with Live process and bridge /status reachable.

title: Introduce action risk policy for MCP tools
goal: Create the safety layer needed before exposing destructive production actions broadly.
acceptanceCriteria: Classify MCP tools and HTTP endpoints into read, safe-write, destructive, export, and unsupported risk tiers.
Provide a reusable policy module that callers can use before mutating Ableton state.
Add tests for classification and default blocking recommendations.

title: Design VST and preset intelligence catalog
goal: Move from raw browser search to musically useful VST and preset selection.
acceptanceCriteria: Define a local catalog format for instruments, effects, tags, realism hints, and classical production intent.
Add matching/scoring behavior for user intents like realistic violin, concert piano, classical guitar, flute, and concert hall mastering.
Add deterministic tests for catalog matching without requiring Ableton.

title: Expand snapshot and rollback coverage
goal: Make rollback semantics reliable enough for guarded production edits.
acceptanceCriteria: Document the current rollback coverage and gaps for tempo, signature, clips, devices, routing, sends, and master chain.
Improve deterministic snapshot coverage for devices, mixer state, sends, returns, and master chain.
Keep Remote Script limitations explicit instead of claiming unsupported rollback safety.

title: Add bridge observability and version diagnostics
goal: Expose enough runtime metadata to debug product issues quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: Define bridge/version metadata including build hash or installed file timestamps, Live PID, endpoint support, and last error.
Add deterministic observability support without requiring Ableton.
Document how observability helps diagnose stale Remote Script runtime issues.

title: Write product workflow documentation
goal: Make the MCP usable as a product without requiring internal knowledge of the repo.
acceptanceCriteria: Document end-to-end workflows for setup, MIDI import, instrument assignment, mixing, mastering, validation, and export.
Document safe operating rules for open user sets and destructive commands.
Align README product language with the current endpoint set.

title: Create Ableton compatibility matrix
goal: Give users clear expectations about which product capabilities work in their Ableton edition.
acceptanceCriteria: Document endpoint support expectations for Live Lite, Standard, Suite, Live 11, and Live 12 where known.
Mark unsupported Remote Script behaviors as explicit 501 expectations, not bugs.
Add a deterministic check that compatibility metadata stays parseable and complete.

title: Design high-level musical workflow tools
goal: Provide product-level operations above raw endpoint calls for music production.
acceptanceCriteria: Define high-level workflows for classical session setup, instrument assignment, mix balancing, reverb cleanup, mastering prep, and render validation.
Represent each workflow as a deterministic plan over existing MCP tools without directly mutating Ableton.
Add tests that generated plans use only known tool names and declare risk tiers.

title: Integrate product workstreams and deterministic QA
goal: Integrate subagent product workstreams, wire deterministic tests, and capture remaining endpoint/product gaps without requiring live Ableton mutation.
acceptanceCriteria: New deterministic tests added by product workstreams are wired into npm test or explicitly documented as direct-only.
Product modules exposed by workers are integration-reviewed for missing endpoint/tool wiring and captured as follow-up tasks if out of scope.
Full deterministic validation suite passes after subagent changes are integrated.

title: Fix ambiguous Live mixer volume contract
goal: Prevent raw Ableton mixer parameter values from being reported as dB and make read/write volume units explicit.
acceptanceCriteria: Live project summaries no longer label raw mixer parameter values as volumeDb or cueVolumeDb.
Read models expose raw mixer values separately from dB values where available.
Tests and docs cover the read/write unit contract so users do not send readback raw values into volumeDb writes.
testStrategy: npm test plus py_compile for changed Python Remote Script files; live runtime validation requires reinstalling the Remote Script into Ableton Live and restarting Live.
